data.body:
Re-run with the fixed harness, 2026-11-12 21:48–22:26 PST, fresh (no --resume), from the worktree at the fix commit, with REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml and AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock. Exit 0, schema_version 2, valid true, 11 rows.
- agreement 8/11 (0.727). Confusion matrix (pipeline → agentic): PASS→PASS 6, PASS→BLOCK 2, BLOCK→BLOCK 2, BLOCK→PASS 1. Blocking flips: 3.
- Overlap (overflow now counted): matched 0, pipeline_only 120, agentic_only 58.
- Agreement with the historical pipeline verdict: pipeline 6/10, agentic 5/10.
- Excluded: none for either engine.
- Every record names runner pydantic_ai. The pipeline records name bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5, which is the verifier-class model the verdict stamps, not the Pass-1 frontier model. The agentic records name bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5. ran_model is null on all 22 records because neither engine's verdict carried provider_provenance on this path.
- Matched 0 at Jaccard >= 0.5: the two engines word their findings differently enough that token-set matching finds no pair. That is a limit of the overlap measure, which this change leaves as it is.
